original.statement: Cilium 1.17 adds the metric `cilium_identity_cache_timer_duration`, listed under "Added Metrics" in the 1.17 upgrade notes.

decision.reason: [ev-8a664283f86e] lists `cilium_identity_cache_timer_duration` under "1.17 Upgrade Notes › Added Metrics", alongside other new metrics such as [ev-1a97b17bde3d] and [ev-1b1b9343e346]. The notes give no setting, flag or values key that controls the metric. So the only condition the evidence supports is crossing into 1.17.0, which means upgrading from a version below 1.17.0. A narrower condition, such as whether Prometheus metrics are enabled, would go beyond what the evidence says.
